title: What Are Cursor Skills? How to Add the Blink Plugin
summary: Cursor skills package MCP tools into one-command installs. Here's what they are, how they differ from rules and MCP, and how to add 14 Blink skills to your Cursor agent in under 2 minutes.
body_markdown: Rules are always-on instructions loaded into every prompt — they shape how the agent writes code regardless of the task. Skills are on-demand knowledge files invoked when the agent determines they're relevant. Rules set baseline behavior; skills give the agent specialized tools and context for specific workflows like provisioning infrastructure or running deployments.
